tools.name: protect_payment
tools.description: One automatic x402 payment-safety front door: pre-payment ALLOW/BLOCK, duplicate-safe ID binding, policy risk reasons, and optional mined-settlement verification. Free and rate-limited; the buyer signs and pays.

tools.name: check_base_swap
tools.description: Wallet-free approved-token Base swap safety preflight. Costs $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: get_safe_swap_quote
tools.description: Safety-checked noncustodial Base swap quote. Costs $0.01 USDC; the buyer signs and broadcasts.

tools.name: prove_safe_action
tools.description: Create a signed pre-sign ALLOW, BLOCK, or REVIEW receipt. Costs $0.05 USDC.

tools.name: check_wallet_risk
tools.description: Read-only Base wallet account-posture check. Costs $0.01 USDC.

tools.name: check_token_risk
tools.description: Approved Base token risk and liquidity check. Costs $0.03 USDC.

tools.name: preflight_transaction
tools.description: Decode and simulate approved Base ERC-20 calldata or SafeRoute's exact official ERC-8004 registration. Costs $0.05 USDC.

tools.name: prepare_token_transfer
tools.description: Prepare a bounded, simulated unsigned Base token transfer. Costs $0.10 USDC.

tools.name: guard_base_trade
tools.description: Complete pre-sign trade guard with route and simulation evidence. Costs $0.12 USDC.

tools.name: verify_transaction_intent
tools.description: Compare a mined Base transaction with buyer intent. Costs $0.05 USDC.

tools.name: verify_swap_execution
tools.description: Verify a standard-mode SafeRoute Base execution against its signed receipt. Free; referral payouts remain disabled.

tools.name: route_agent_payment
tools.description: Prepare a bounded, simulated exact-buy route to a payer-owned Base USDC target covering the x402 payment and optional buffer. Costs $0.05 USDC; buyer confirms funding, then retries standard x402 once.

tools.name: list_supported_assets
tools.description: List SafeRoute's seven approved Base assets, limits, fees, and execution modes. Free.
